spans.s:
mn. (-फः-फं)
1 A hoof in general.
2 The root of a tree.
3 The hoof of a horse.
E.
शम to be tranquil, aff. अच्, and the final changed to फ.

mf. (-रः-री)
A small fish, (Cyprinus Sophore HAM.)
E.
शफ a hoof, रा to give, (to resemble,) aff. क.

mf. (-रः-री)
A small glistening fish, commonly Punthi, a sort of carp, (Cyprinus sophore, HAM.)
E.
श the initial changed to सः see शफर.

m. (-पः)
The Ilisha or Hilsa fish, (Ilisha clupanodon.)
E.
शफर a carp, and अधिप chief.

m. (-कः)
A fisherman.
E.
शफर a kind of fish, put for any, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-ली-लं)
Productive, fruitful, bearing fruit, yielding a profit, &c.
E.
स for सह with, and फल fruit.

n. (-ल्यं)
Productiveness, fruitfulness.
E.
स with, फल fruit, प्यञ् aff.
